name: join_one_to_many
comment: A collection join (FK on the target): ON pairs are parent key = target FK. No paging — a paged collection join is refused by the session (REL-005) before rendering, so the AST case renders the unpaged form only.

sqlite.sql: select t.id as t_id, t.name as t_name, t.email as t_email, t.display_name as t_display_name, t.created_at as t_created_at, t.updated_at as t_updated_at, j0.id as j0_id, j0.user_id as j0_user_id, j0.status as j0_status, j0.amount as j0_amount, j0.version as j0_version, j0.note as j0_note, j0.created_at as j0_created_at, j0.updated_at as j0_updated_at from users t left join transactions j0 on j0.user_id = t.id where t.name like @c0
